question: Should Reef permanently own and support a second production relay platform based on Node, PostgreSQL, SMTP, containers, and Kubernetes?
rationale: This creates a substantial operational and release surface whose long-term ownership cannot be inferred from patch correctness or CI.

options.title: Sponsor the platform
options.body: Approve the second relay platform after the contributor fixes the blocking defaults and supplies live install, upgrade, and delivery proof.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare-only
options.body: Decline the added operational surface and close or redirect the Kubernetes implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the platform
recommendation.body: Approve the second relay platform after the contributor fixes the blocking defaults and supplies live install, upgrade, and delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current design identifies Peter as its approver, making him the best available owner for an expansion of the relay architecture.
